contractEnforcements.classifierScope: renderer/js/r3-0e-outcome-classifier.js exports classifyOutcome(input, opts) → { valid: true, outcome } | blocked envelope, and verifyAuthoritativeOutcome(candidate) → boolean. NO other public surface. NO WeakSet, register function, secret, or signing primitive exported. NO mutation of vehicle preset / setup file / calibration / model / telemetry / feature-registry / R3.0B case-record schema. NO LLM, NO runtime config, NO filesystem, NO randomness.
contractEnforcements.inputAuthority: Input wrapper has a CLOSED key set: {experiment, appliedChange, followUp, observation, controlVariableObservations}. Caller-supplied `class`, `outcome`, `confounders`, `comparabilityScore`, or any unknown own key on the wrapper → BLOCK with UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY before any further [[Get]] read. Each nested sub-object also has a CLOSED key set. Each control-variable observation is validated via the E1 CV contract; observedValue + withinRange MUST be filled (E3 algorithm requirement on top of E1 shape).
contractEnforcements.experimentBinding: experiment.status MUST be 'applied'; experiment.outcome MUST be null (E1 already enforces this for status=applied, defence-in-depth in classifier too); appliedChange.sourceExperimentId MUST equal experiment.experimentId; followUp.parentCaseId MUST equal experiment.sourceCaseId. Any binding mismatch → BLOCK (EXPERIMENT_STATUS_INVALID / OUTCOME_INVALID).
contractEnforcements.comparisonValidityPrecedence: invalid_comparison takes precedence over inconclusive/confirmed when ANY of: followUp.parentCaseId !== experiment.sourceCaseId (cross-case forbidden), followUp.sessionId !== followUp.parentSessionId (cross-session forbidden), followUp.hasExplicitReference !== true (R3.0C explicit-reference policy), followUp.comparabilityScore < 0.5 (low-comparability threshold). Limitations carried per signal: LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING / LIMITATION_CROSS_SESSION_FOLLOW_UP / OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT.
contractEnforcements.confounderPrecedence: inconclusive_due_to_confounders takes precedence over confirmed/contradicted when: any declared experiment.controlVariables[].name is missing from controlVariableObservations (limitation: CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING; confounders = missing names) OR any control variable observation has withinRange === false (limitation: CONTROL_VARIABLE_OUT_OF_RANGE; confounders = out-of-range names). When NO control variables are declared AND none observed, classification proceeds normally but limitation LIMITATION_NO_CONTROL_VARIABLES is carried.
contractEnforcements.classificationCascade: After invalid_comparison / inconclusive_due_to_confounders gates pass, the cascade is: dataQualityIssues.length > 4 → inconclusive (with dq codes propagated to limitations); observedDirection === null → inconclusive; contradictingEvidenceIds.length > 0 → contradicted (blocks confirmed even if direction matches); !directionMatch → contradicted; directionMatch AND magnitudeInRange → confirmed; directionMatch AND !magnitudeInRange → partially_confirmed.
contractEnforcements.clockOrdering: Clock (opts.clock || opts.referenceNowMs) is invoked AT MOST ONCE, in Step 9, AFTER input wrapper descriptor snapshot, experiment shape, appliedChange/followUp/observation/CV descriptor snapshots, opts snapshot, AND identity binding (status/sourceExperimentId/parentCaseId). Forged input fails earlier in the cascade → ZERO clock invocations. Hostile clock throwing or returning a non-string → BLOCK with no partial output.
contractEnforcements.producerAttestation: classifyOutcome registers every successfully-classified outcome envelope in a closure-private WeakSet (_authoritativeOutcomes). verifyAuthoritativeOutcome(candidate) checks identity (WeakSet membership) AND structural witnesses (Object.isFrozen, schemaVersion, outcomeId/experimentId/class strings, confounders/limitations arrays). Clones, JSON round-trips, structuredClone outputs, hand-forged frozen lookalikes, and Proxy objects do NOT pass. WeakSet operations dispatched via captured WeakSet.prototype.add/has + captured Reflect.apply so post-load WeakSet.prototype.has = () => true cannot defeat verification.
contractEnforcements.capturedIntrinsics: Object.freeze / Object.isFrozen / Object.is / Object.getOwnPropertyNames / Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor / Object.getOwnPropertySymbols / Object.getPrototypeOf / Array.isArray / Date.parse / Reflect.apply / JSON.stringify / TextEncoder / Number.isFinite / Number.isInteger / WeakSet ctor + prototype methods are captured at module init so post-load ambient rebind cannot affect validation.
contractEnforcements.outcomeShape: Output passes through E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape before deep-freeze + registration. Envelope byte cap 128 KiB. outcomeId is deterministic FNV-1a hash of (experimentId, changeId) — NO clock leak. createdAt is the resolved clock ISO (or appliedChange.appliedAt fallback). NO causal language, NO driver-blame language, NO free-text driver feedback (i18n key only), NO raw telemetry, NO filesystem path, NO stack trace.
contractEnforcements.stateFloors: E3 unlocks algorithmsAllowed=true ONLY for renderer/js/r3-0e-outcome-classifier.js (the exact authorized path). uiAllowed remains false (E5 only). featureRegistryActivationAllowed remains false (E5 only). R3.0B case-record schema is NOT modified (r3bCaseRecordSchemaUntouched=true).

note: R3.0E E3_OUTCOME_CLASSIFIER — deterministic Outcome Classifier algorithm with closure-private WeakSet producer attestation. classifyOutcome derives all classification fields from authoritative inputs (Experiment, AppliedChange, FollowUp identity, Observation, ControlVariableObservations); caller-supplied class/outcome/confounders are rejected before any [[Get]] read. Precedence: invalid_comparison > inconclusive_due_to_confounders > inconclusive > contradicted > partially_confirmed > confirmed. Clock at most once post-authority. No UI; no Feature Registry change.
